{{Top|leg}}
'''Siphoning balloons''' were used by [[Tibanna tapper]]s to siphon [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna]] gas from a [[Tibanna gas platform]]. After siphoning off the gas, tappers would use a [[Spacetug/Legends|tug]] to move the siphoning balloons to another location.

In [[36 ABY]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and [[Zekk]] prevented a group of [[Membrosia/Legends|membrosia]]-addicted [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] tappers who were using a tug and three balloons on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].
